overview: Operand kaise specify hota hai: immediate, direct, indirect, register, indexed, based, relative, auto-increment. Position-independent code aur high-level construct ke saath matching.
coreConcept: Effective address (EA) = operand ka address, mode ke rule se banta hai.
hinglishExplanation: Relative mode (PC + offset) position-independent code ke liye best hai kyunki code ke saath hi move ho jaata hai. Indexed/base modes arrays aur structs ke liye. Immediate constants ke liye. Indirect pointers ke liye.
formalDefinition: Effective address (EA) = operand ka address, mode ke rule se banta hai.
importantProperties: Relative: EA = PC + offset (position independent, branches).
commonPitfalls: PC ki value (next instruction) use karna bhoolna.
Indirect me extra memory access ignore.
standardTechniques: EA formula likho phir memory se value uthao.
